# Marketplace admin panel

*Client industry: e-commerce | Completed: 2024-01-20 | Evidence id: fullstack:case:p02*

## The problem
The client was a second-hand furniture marketplace moderating listings in spreadsheets.

## What I did
I scoped the work with the client, then built the solution using a component-based single-page frontend, TypeScript, a typed query API for the mobile app, a JavaScript backend. I kept the client in the loop with short weekly demos and wrote handover notes.

## Result
The project cut moderation time per listing from 3 minutes to 40 seconds.
